name: nonApi_logPortalError
description: Inserts an HC6 portal error entry into HC.ErrorLog. Called by PortalApiHC6.LogErrorAsync when an HC6 portal SP returns Success = 0 in its error envelope. Fire-and-forget — errors from this SP are swallowed by the caller.

parameters.name: errorName
parameters.description: Short error label from the SP's error envelope. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL — parameter is wider (500 vs 250); values longer than 250 will be silently truncated by SQL Server on insert.

parameters.name: errorDescription
parameters.description: Full error description from the SP's error envelope. Nullable — not all error paths include a description. Table column is NVARCHAR(2500) NULL — parameter is wider (MAX vs 2500); values longer than 2500 will be silently truncated on insert.

parameters.name: procName
parameters.description: Name of the HC6 SP that raised the error. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL — parameter is wider (500 vs 250); values longer than 250 will be silently truncated.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Device UUID stored as userId for audit trail. Nullable — portal auth may not always have a userId. Table column is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL.

sideEffects: Inserts 1 row into HC.ErrorLog with HcVersion = 'HC6-API', id = NEWID(), createdAt = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME().

codeSmells.issue: Parameter types wider than target columns — silent truncation risk
codeSmells.detail: @errorName is NVARCHAR(500) but HC.ErrorLog.ErrorName is NVARCHAR(250). @errorDescription is NVARCHAR(MAX) but HC.ErrorLog.ErrorDescription is NVARCHAR(2500). @procName is NVARCHAR(500) but HC.ErrorLog.ProcName is NVARCHAR(250). Values exceeding column lengths are silently truncated on insert. No runtime error is raised.

breakingChanges: HC5 used inline SQL in PortalApiHC6.LogErrorAsync rather than a dedicated SP. HC6 extracts this into a named SP so the logging pattern is consistent and testable.
